notes: INSTALL THIS ONE BY HAND and select your edition. Silent updates have been re-branding X-Series installs as Kraftech - the edition check compared a display string that could never match, so every update passed the Kraftech edition and rewrote the splash, Start-menu group and Add/Remove name. Fixed, but the fix only applies to updates made FROM a build containing it, so one manual install is needed to break the cycle. ONE J move per face: joint moves bow unpredictably between poses and that bow is invisible in the waypoint list - a generated program came within a millimetre of the web. The first J entering a face does the reconfigure, every later J on that face becomes a straight-line move, enforced as a single pass so it cannot be partially applied. Updater also: the download progress dialog now actually appears, a locked leftover installer no longer blocks the save, that failure says why, and every step logs to %TEMP%\NC3_update.log.
